text: Yes, the NeoCell Super Collagen Peptides product is listed as unflavored [S4]. However, reviewers note that it is not truly flavorless, describing it as having a slightly bitter, chalky, or unappealing taste [S1, S3]. Regarding mixing, reviewers state that it does not dissolve well or gets chunky in cold water [S1, S3], but it blends completely in soups or sauces [S1, S2] and dissolves unnoticed into coffee [S2] or mixes best in warm/hot water [S3].
